_comment: Outside jobs for GET /api/v1/autonomy (contract: autonomy catalogue, P-00092 e7816874, + the coordinator's `notes` and statuses-outside-the-enum additions). The five Brigade items come from scheduled-runs.json. '$now-…' and '$lastFire±…' (the job's most recent scheduled fire) tokens here are resolved PER REQUEST (not at startup) so an ok job stays ok however long the mock runs. Health is computed by the mock from the contract's rules, never stored. A job with no `runs` entry answers GET …/runs with its last run. busy: build-log-refresh reports `running`. Hosts, owners and paths are realistic but illustrative.

jobs.name: Build Log refresh
jobs.responsibility: Turns the day's commits across the org into Build Log stories and redeploys the Build Log page.
jobs.lastSummary: 3 new day stories, 1 refreshed. Build Log redeployed.
jobs.notes: Found in: gpu-01 crontab (ops) line 3. Reports to the catalogue since 2026-10-24.

jobs.name: Lead-gen morning runner
jobs.responsibility: Stages the morning outreach wave from the lead desk and queues each send for Sam's tap; it never sends on its own.
jobs.lastSummary: Staged 10 sends for review; no bounces overnight.

jobs.name: Fleet health monitor
jobs.responsibility: Probes every host and public endpoint every five minutes and raises the alarm in the Command Center when one stops answering.
jobs.lastSummary: 14 of 14 endpoints answering; slowest 412 ms (the edge-01 gateway).

jobs.name: Disk guard
jobs.responsibility: Checks free space on the studio Mac's volumes every hour and warns before the system drive drops under 60 GB.
jobs.lastSummary: System drive 48 GiB free (under the 60 GB line); media volume 512 GiB free.

jobs.name: Certificate renewal check
jobs.responsibility: Renews the house's Let's Encrypt certificates before they expire and reports any it couldn't renew.
jobs.lastError: Couldn't renew muhq.accessmy.house: the DNS challenge timed out after 120 s because the Cloudflare token can't edit that zone. The certificate expires in 12 days.
jobs.notes: Found in: gpu-01 root crontab line 11. The DNS token it uses is scoped to the company zones only.

jobs.name: Notes call sync
jobs.responsibility: Imports recorded calls from Apple Notes into Meeting-Ops every 15 minutes so their transcripts and action items land in one place.
jobs.lastSummary: Imported 2 calls; skipped 1 with no speech.
jobs.notes: Found in: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.magicunicorn.notes-call-sync.plist. Waiting on a Full Disk Access click since 2026-10-17; the app version replaces it.

jobs.name: Weekly release notes draft
jobs.responsibility: Drafts the week's release notes from merged pull requests and leaves them for review; it never publishes.

jobs.name: Footage catalogue indexer
jobs.responsibility: Watches the footage archive and indexes each new recording — frames, transcript and summary — so it shows up in Footage Search.
jobs.scheduleNote: Continuous: wakes when a recording lands in the archive
jobs.lastSummary: Indexed 41 clips; the queue is empty.

jobs.name: ZFS scrub (tank)
jobs.responsibility: Scrubs the tank pool on the first of each month and reports checksum errors before they turn into data loss.
jobs.lastSummary: Scrub repaired 0 B in 9 h 41 min with 0 errors.
jobs.notes: Found in: gpu-01 root crontab line 4.

jobs.name: SnapRAID sync
jobs.responsibility: Updates parity for the archive disks every night so one dead disk can be rebuilt.
jobs.lastError: snapraid sync stopped: disk d4 (ZA215MPQ) returned I/O errors, so parity was not updated.
jobs.notes: FAILING: d4 has failed every night since 2026-10-19; replacing it is on the storage project. Found in: gpu-01 root crontab line 9.

jobs.name: SMART health check
jobs.responsibility: Reads SMART data from every disk each morning and flags reallocated or pending sectors.
jobs.lastSummary: 14 disks checked; d4 shows 312 pending sectors.

jobs.name: GPU power cap
jobs.responsibility: Applies the 300 W and 200 W power limits to the two GPUs at boot so they can never overdraw the power supply together.
jobs.lastSummary: Capped the RTX 6000 at 300 W and the second GPU at 200 W.
jobs.notes: Found in: /etc/systemd/system/gpu-power-cap.service (enabled). Read nvidia-smi power.limit to confirm it applied.

jobs.name: RTX 6000 fan control
jobs.responsibility: Drives the case fans from the RTX 6000’s temperature; the card has no fans of its own.
jobs.scheduleNote: Continuous: follows the card temperature every 5 s
jobs.lastSummary: 6000 at 61 °C; case fans at 48 %.

jobs.name: Offsite backup (restic)
jobs.responsibility: Sends the night’s tank snapshot to the offsite repository and checks a sample of it.
jobs.lastError: restic stopped after 4 h: the upload stalled at 61 % (812 GB of 1.3 TB) when the uplink dropped.

jobs.name: Photo library dedupe
jobs.responsibility: Merges duplicate photos across the family libraries every Sunday morning.
jobs.lastSummary: Merged 41 duplicates.
jobs.notes: BROKEN: script missing since the 2026-04-30 git stash; recovered copy in scripts/recovered-20260825/. Found in: gpu-01 crontab (ops) line 7.

jobs.name: Docker image prune
jobs.responsibility: Clears dangling images and build cache every Sunday so the system disk never fills.
jobs.lastSummary: Freed 38 GB of dangling images.

jobs.name: Postgres nightly dump
jobs.responsibility: Dumps every Postgres database on app-01 to the backup share and keeps fourteen days.
jobs.lastSummary: Dumped 14 databases (61 GB); 14 days kept.

jobs.name: Vaultwarden backup
jobs.responsibility: Copies the Vaultwarden database and attachments to the backup share every night.
jobs.lastSummary: Database and attachments copied (212 MB).
jobs.notes: Found in: app-01 root crontab line 2. Stopped reporting after the 2026-10-21 host move.

jobs.name: Certificate expiry watch
jobs.responsibility: Checks every certificate Traefik serves and warns two weeks before one expires.
jobs.lastSummary: 31 certificates; the soonest expires in 12 days (muhq.accessmy.house).

jobs.name: GitHub mirror refresh
jobs.responsibility: Pushes each community repo’s main branch from Forgejo to its GitHub mirror every night.
jobs.lastSummary: 13 repos pushed; 4 held until the licence question is answered.

jobs.name: Pi radio stream check
jobs.responsibility: Checks the Pi radio stream every ten minutes and restarts it when it goes quiet.
jobs.lastSummary: Stream endpoint answered 200.
jobs.notes: ORPHAN: aimed at pi-01, retired since 2026-09-25. Its 200 comes from the fallback page, so it can only ever pass.

jobs.name: Log rotation
jobs.responsibility: Rotates and compresses service logs every night.
jobs.lastSummary: Rotated 46 logs; 3.1 GB freed.

jobs.name: Kokoro warm-up
jobs.responsibility: Keeps the Kokoro voice server warm through the day so the first spoken line is never a cold start.
jobs.lastSummary: af_heart answered in 640 ms.

jobs.name: Model server health
jobs.responsibility: Asks every local model lane for a one-token answer every ten minutes and reports the ones that don’t answer.
jobs.lastError: The P40 lane answered 503 three checks running: qwen3.6 is reloading its weights after an out-of-memory restart.

jobs.name: Kokoro voice catalogue sync
jobs.responsibility: Rebuilds the voice catalogue every night so new voices show up in every app.
jobs.notes: FAILING: exits 1 every night since the Python 3.13 upgrade (distutils is gone), so it has never reported. Found in: edge-01 crontab (root) line 12.

jobs.name: Model cache cleanup
jobs.responsibility: Deletes model checkpoints no lane has loaded in thirty days, every Monday.
jobs.lastSummary: Removed 3 unused checkpoints (96 GB).

jobs.name: OBS recording archiver
jobs.responsibility: Moves finished OBS recordings from the studio Mac to the archive on gpu-01 and verifies each copy.
jobs.lastSummary: Moved 6 recordings (212 GB) and verified each copy.
jobs.notes: Found in: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.magicunicorn.obs-archive.plist. The Mac slept through its 03:00 slot four nights running.

jobs.name: Time Machine check
jobs.responsibility: Confirms every morning that the last Time Machine backup is less than a day old.
jobs.lastSummary: Last backup 47 minutes old.

jobs.name: Public site probes
jobs.responsibility: Loads the public sites and app logins from outside the house every five minutes.
jobs.lastSummary: Both websites and 4 app logins answered.

jobs.name: Unattended upgrades
jobs.responsibility: Installs security updates on the VPS every morning and says when a reboot is due.
jobs.lastSummary: 2 security updates installed; no reboot needed.

jobs.name: Morning cash position
jobs.responsibility: Posts the morning cash position and runway from Accounting-Ops to the Stable room on weekdays.
jobs.lastSummary: Cash across 3 accounts posted; runway 9.6 months.

jobs.name: Court docket watch
jobs.responsibility: Checks the court dockets for the open matters every four hours and files any new entry with its matter.
jobs.lastSummary: No new entries on the 2 open matters.

jobs.name: Support inbox triage
jobs.responsibility: Sorts the support inbox every two hours: drafts the replies it can for approval and labels the rest.
jobs.lastSummary: Sorted 12 messages; 3 drafts waiting for approval.
jobs.notes: Paused 2026-10-20 while the Email-Ops rule actions shipped; turn it back on after the inbox move.

jobs.name: Customer domain watch
jobs.responsibility: Checks customers’ domains twice a day for hijacks and unexpected DNS changes.
jobs.lastSummary: 11 domains checked; DNS unchanged.

jobs.name: Nightly metrics rollup
jobs.responsibility: Rolls the day’s app events up into the daily metrics tables every night.
jobs.lastSummary: Rolled 1.9 M events into 6 daily tables.

jobs.name: Agent card certification sweep
jobs.responsibility: Re-reads every agent’s spec card each Monday and lists the ones whose builds no longer match it.

jobs.name: Receipts inbox OCR
jobs.responsibility: Reads new receipts from the receipts inbox every twenty minutes and matches each to a transaction.
jobs.lastSummary: Read 2 receipts; both matched a transaction.

jobs.name: Weekly dependency audit
jobs.responsibility: Audits every repo’s dependencies on Monday mornings and drafts upgrade PRs; it never merges.
jobs.lastSummary: 3 advisories across 2 repos; PRs drafted, none merged.
